Noah and the Little Cloud

A tiny cloud follows Noah through the garden, watering flowers and washing a muddy duck. Can he help it find its family before bedtime?

Read the whole storyMake one like this

Noah’s story

Read the story below, or open the page-turning reader.

A tiny cloud.

Noah found a tiny cloud behind a pot. “Hello,” said Noah. Drip! One little raindrop landed on his nose.

A little giggle.

The cloud made another drop. Drip! Noah giggled. The cloud wiggled. A red flower nearby looked very thirsty.

Drip, drop, plop.

Noah carried the cloud to the flowers. Drip, drop, plop! Up popped red. Up popped yellow. Up popped blue.

Quack, quack!

A little duck came down the path. It was brown with mud. “Oh, duck!” said Noah. “You need a wash.”

A clean little duck.

The cloud made gentle rain. Splish, splash! Noah wiped the duck. Yellow feathers shone. “Quack!” said the happy duck.

Red, yellow, blue.

The sun found the raindrops. A rainbow curved over the garden. Noah reached up. The cloud sparkled beside him.

Where is your family?

The little cloud looked at the sky. Big clouds floated far away. “Is that your family?” Noah asked. The cloud gave a tiny nod.

Step, step, step.

Noah walked up the grassy hill. Step, step, step. The duck followed. The little cloud floated close above his hands.

Together again.

At the top, the cloud family waited. The little cloud zoomed up. Drip, drop, hooray! Noah waved goodbye.

A cloud by the moon.

Noah slept snug in bed. Outside, the clouds made a moon shape. “Goodnight, little cloud,” Noah whispered.
